---
title: "Add login sessions without rewriting the sessions array"
description: "Drop when the pinned release adds login sessions and logs out without writing back the user it read (issue 16027; PR 18150 covers login only), and concurrent-session-refresh no longer uses the $remove operator this patch adds."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.2. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

Concurrent logins as one user fail or lose their sessions. Login reads the
user with its sessions, hashes the password, then writes the whole user back
with the new session appended. The SQL adapters write an array by deleting
all of its rows and inserting them again. D1 has no transactions, so the
logins interleave those statements: eight logins at once return one 200 and
seven 500s with "UNIQUE constraint failed: users_sessions.id". On Postgres
every login returns 200, but each one writes back the sessions it read, so
the sessions of the other logins disappear and their tokens stop working.
Logging out of one session, and the cleanup after a login fails, rewrite the
array the same way. Logging out of every session writes back the whole user
it read, hash and salt included, so it undoes a password change that lands
between its read and its write.

Login now removes the expired sessions it read, by ID, then adds its session
with $push, which the SQL adapters write as one insert. Logging out of one
session and the cleanup after a failed login remove only that session.
Logging out of every session writes only an empty sessions array. updateOne
accepts { $remove: id | id[] } on a top-level array field: the SQL adapters
delete those rows, in batches that stay within D1's 100 bound parameters,
and MongoDB pulls them. Session expiry, refresh and password changes keep
their behaviour here, and concurrent-session-refresh changes refresh with
$remove. MongoDB with transactions still rejects concurrent writes to one
user with a WriteConflict, as before.

- **Patch:** `concurrent-login-sessions`, committed as `fix(payload): add login sessions without rewriting the sessions array`
- **Upstream:** [https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/16027](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/issues/16027)
